context: Revenue increased year on year while total consolidated profit decreased. This does not by itself establish deteriorating core operations.

events.title: Revenue rises; profit comparison needs context
events.summary: Q4 FY25 consolidated revenue was INR 40925 crore; total PAT was INR 7038 crore. Tax-refund interest differed materially from the prior year.

events.title: MRE Consulting acquisition agreed
events.summary: A subsidiary agreed to acquire MRE Consulting for up to USD 36 million including earn-outs, excluding management incentives and retention bonuses. This historical disclosure is an agreement, not completion.

events.title: McCamish settlement proposal remains subject to approval
events.summary: McCamish reached an in-principle class-action settlement for USD 17.5 million, subject to finalisation and court approval, without admission of liability. The filing records USD 17 million of insurance reimbursement receivable.

events.title: INR 22 final dividend recommended
events.summary: The board recommended INR 22 per share for FY25, subject to shareholder approval. The filing specified 30 May 2025 as record date.

events.title: Employee stock-unit grant approved
events.summary: The board approved 5000 RSUs for eligible employees under the 2015 Plan, effective 2 May 2025 and vesting over four years.

events.title: Quarterly EBITDA outpaces revenue growth
events.summary: Q4 FY25 revenue increased 25% and EBITDA increased 35% year on year. The company reported 14.7% EBITDA margin and a turnaround in FMEG quarterly profitability.

events.title: Growth continues; sequential margins have a base effect
events.summary: Q4 FY26 INR revenue increased 25.1% year on year. Sequential profit growth follows a quarter affected by the new labour codes; the release explicitly flags that comparison.

limitations: Three companies have verified historical results fixtures; only Infosys has transcript-grounded guidance in this fixture set.
Several Infosys insight cards derive from one filing and must not be counted as distinct exchange filings.
No data here establishes a live 24-hour feed, latest prices or latest quarter.
No incoming-management biography was researched; the material governance-related event is the proposed McCamish litigation settlement.
Do not reconstruct exact prior-quarter values from rounded reported growth rates.
Primary company press releases are eligible for push enrichment, not for the stricter annual-report/transcript-only pull corpus.
